title: A film changes with everything tied to it
statement: A film's captions, transcript and checks must match the film that plays, so they change with it.
example: Swapping only one lesson's video file would have left its check and five transcript segments out of step.
detail: A draft plan to replace a reading lesson's opening film found that the installed film carried a check and five short transcript segments, so replacing only the video file would leave them mismatched, and it requires the film, poster, captions, transcript, title and check contract to be replaced together and then tested in the lesson. The same plan keeps pauses, response screens and feedback in the app, not burned into the video (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/video-2026-09-16/PETER-PAN-PART-1-FILM.md`, lines 53 and 58).
against: The plan is a draft: nothing has been made or installed under it, and it awaits reconciliation with a reviewed script (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/video-2026-09-16/PETER-PAN-PART-1-FILM.md`, line 7).
